orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To construct a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon, we will prioritize investment-grade securities with a minimum credit rating of BBB+ to ensure stability and predictable cash flows. A laddered maturity structure is essential, where no more than 30% of the portfolio matures in any single year. This approach spreads out the maturity dates across the 5-year period, reducing interest rate risk and providing a steady income stream. We will allocate the portfolio across different maturity buckets to maintain a balanced duration. Given the 5-year horizon, we aim to keep the portfolio duration below 10 years, with a target of around 5-6 years to align with the client's time frame. The proposed allocation will be divided into 5 maturity buckets: 0-1 year, 1-2 years, 2-3 years, 3-4 years, and 4-5 years, with approximately 20% allocated to each bucket to maintain the laddered structure and adhere to the 30% single-year maturity limit.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Allocate 40% to bonds, with a laddered maturity structure of 20% in each of the 5 maturity buckets: 0-1 year, 1-2 years, 2-3 years, 3-4 years, and 4-5 years. The specific bonds to be allocated are: 20% to 1-year Commercial Paper (A+ rating), 20% to 2-year Treasury Note (AAA rating), 0% to other asset classes within bonds due to the 40% cap, and the remaining 60% to other asset classes not specified by the bonds sub-agent. Note that the bonds sub-agent proposed a 100% allocation to bonds, but this exceeds the 40% maximum allowed for any single asset class.
